description: Find a verified nurse by NUID (e.g. PB410785), name or state-council registration number. Optional state is a two-letter prefix (PB) or a state name (punjab). Contacts are masked. A miss is not proof the nurse is unregistered.

council.description: Council slug from a search result

state.description: Two-letter prefix or state name, e.g. PB or punjab

name: search_nurses
